GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. weakened in Straight # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider stated that his intention was to lead in the event, which he was able to do comfortably in the early stages after beginning well. He added, however, that after obtaining the lead, horse commenced to race keenly for some distance throughout the early and middle stages, which, in his opinion, was detrimental to its finishing effort.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward to lead .5 Lengths 1000m lead .5 Lengths 600m eq lead home turn 1st 3 Lengths kicked away 250m to win with authority # led/easy win
Jumped Well Went Forward to lead .5 Lengths 1200m took sit 2nd 1 Lengths 800m 2nd rail .5 Lengths home turn Under Pressure 1st weakened final 200m # on pace/weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the disappointing performance, Rider stated that his instructions were to settle in an on-pace position, which he was able to do comfortably. He said, however, that throughout the early and middle stages was pressured by runner to his outside, which resulted in his mount racing keenly through the middle stages and, in his opinion, this was detrimental to its finishing effort. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, ridden along a touch turn, Straightened Up half clear, headed 200m and gave ground # led/headed 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the lead throughout the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well. Pushed fwd & shared lead on inside early . Held 1/2L lead on inside midrace until joined in front @ 400m. Pushed to quicken =lead on inside on home turn. Headed @ 250m & faded in last 200m. Blinkers First Time # Led & weakened
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. got up fence turn hard ridden 3 lengths. battled away late # Ordinary Effort
Jumped Well to lead half clear, headed 600m, under pressure turn and dropped out # poor/amiss?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr Std he was instructed to obtain a prominent position. after beginning quite well, when a number of rnrs to his outside showed speed in e/stages, he made some use of his mnt to secure the lead. The gelding travelled strongly, came under heavy riding from 500m &, when commencing to weaken significantly, passing 200m, he desisted from riding the gelding out. In his view, mnt may not have handled the 8 day backup.  A post-race vet exam didn’t reveal any abs. Tnr rep was advised the gelding would be required to barrier trial to the satisfaction of Stwds before being permitted to race again.
